slot.brief: Simple sentence where the verb disagrees with its subject (e.g., 'The list of items are...'); student picks the erroneous part, with 'no error' not among options.

stem:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains an error.

(a) The bouquet of fresh roses / (b) were placed on the reception desk / (c) before the guests arrived / (d) in the evening.
options: were placed on the reception desk

verdicts.working: “Bouquet” is singular, so the verb should be “was,” not “were.”

working:

solution: The head subject “bouquet” is singular, so it takes the singular verb “was,” not “were.”
